description: Translates a StockCharts.com scan (e.g. '[type = stock] and [daily close > daily sma(50,daily close)] and [rsi(14) < 70] rank by [ROC(20)]') into a FinzData signal formula and a ready-to-run backtest spec. Returns expr, universe, notes, and any clauses not yet supported (never guessed). No data is fetched.

start.description: Backtest start for the returned spec (default 2015-01-01).

name: translate_stockcharts_scan
title: Translate a StockCharts scan
